# Backing up data from one cluster and restoring it to another cluster {#oadp-backing-up-data-one-cluster-restoring-another-cluster}

Explore how to back up application data from one OpenShift Container Platform cluster and restore it to another cluster. While more complex than single-cluster operations, {{ oadp_full }} provides the tools to manage this cross-cluster data recovery.
